breaking_changes: Version format changed from X.Y.Z (e.g. 11.9.0) to YYYY.WW.N (e.g. 2026.39.0); pin versions to the new format if you rely on them.

GET /models and GET /pull/variants now return an empty string for registry_source when a model has no explicit source, instead of 'huggingface'; clients that assume a non-empty value may need updating.
GET /docs now returns a JSON 404 instead of falling through to the SPA web-app; use /v1/docs for the API reference.

FLM model download now respects default_model_source config and explicit per-model source always overrides; FLM models without an explicit source fall back to the default rather than always using HuggingFace.

evidence.blockers: Four P0 items: verifying the gpt-oss model loads the correct 63 GB file (last glob entry in registry), confirming the new version format appears in shipped artifacts, validating the prerelease publishing pipeline publishes correctly, and verifying the candidate Docker tag actually installs and runs. These all block a safe ship.
evidence.breaking_changes: The version format change (X.Y.Z to YYYY.WW.N) is a hard break for anyone parsing version strings. The registry_source empty-string default in /models and /pull/variants responses is a subtle API change. The /docs 404 behavior is a deliberate fix that replaces an undocumented SPA fallback. The FLM download precedence change affects FLM users switching between HuggingFace and ModelScope.
evidence.coverage: Reviewed all 41 commits in the range v11.9.0..e71baf2. All 23 to-dos from the commit reviews are rated. The release infrastructure is the most complex surface: version format rewrite, candidate release pipeline, branch creation workflow, and Docker candidate tag are all new and unexercised end-to-end.
evidence.manual_testing: Four new user-facing surfaces need human verification: wildcard allowed_origins patterns, /pull/variants error handling, the docs API (GET /v1/docs) and its MCP tool, and the /images/edit endpoint. The FLM ModelScope download path and session header relay need live integration checks. Soft-idle prompt cache reuse with auto_evict needs end-to-end model serving verification. CI covers compilation and unit tests but not these live paths.
evidence.security: Wildcard allowed_origins (PR #3470) was reviewed by a security-area maintainer with dot-boundary subdomain enforcement. The internal MCP client endpoints were removed (PR #3498), improving posture. The model-viewer vendor pin security hardening (PR #2709) is in this release. Session header relay uses a strict allowlist and is discovery-exempt. No new credential handling or supply-chain risks observed.
